subject: Alembic: 0016_ink_purge_horizon lands now with down_revision 0014; when 0015 lands, point 0016 at it
body:
Your 0015 isn't on the shared tip yet, so I'm integrating 0016_ink_purge_horizon with down_revision '0014' to keep a single head now. When you land 0015_notes_notebooks (down_revision '0014'), please make two small edits in the same commit:
(1) In apps/api/migrations/versions/0016_ink_purge_horizon.py, set down_revision = "0015" and change the docstring's 'Revises: 0014' to 0015.
(2) In apps/api/tests/test_migrate.py, insert "0015" before "0016" in the expected chain.
0016 only adds ink_layers.purged_before_ms and restates the select-only grants, so it doesn't depend on your tables. If you'd rather I make those edits, tell me when 0015 is in and I'll do it.
